However ER sources cite only art-5::cl-1 and art-4::cl-1, omitting the actual timing subclause art-4::cl-1::pt-a and preservation clauses art-5::cl-1::pt-a and art-5::cl-1::pt-b required to understand the complete technical contract.

The source limits only retention and explicitly leaves the in-person duty intact. Removing the false relation and exception must be authored by the agent, not repaired manually.

Retention relations follow definition, public-service scope, retention exception and cross-reference provision within the same pinned corpus. This bounded observation does not cure the source-reference omission under QUALIFIERS.
